items.html: With this there is no room here for the question of how AVI, who are more exalted, become garments for ZON, who are lower in rank than them. And the answer is that “from our flesh we shall envision God” — for the fetus and the embryo is placed within its mother's womb, within her, and it is not for this reason called more exalted than its mother, for this had to be so for the sake of the fetus, so that it be corrected there, as above — for there the external forces have no power to return and cling to these kings.
